name: Exosome Hair Restoration
title: Exosome Hair Restoration in Tustin | OC Concierge Doctor
description: Exosome hair restoration in Tustin with Tariq A. Khan, MD. Scalp injections for thinning, shedding, and early hair loss in men and women.
lede: Exosome hair restoration uses scalp injections to deliver growth-signaling exosomes to hair follicles. It is used for thinning, shedding, and early hair loss in both men and women.
glance: Scalp injections for thinning hair, with growth tracked over months.

signs.heading: Good candidates
signs.intro: Best results are usually seen when follicles are thinning but still present.

basics.heading: How it works
paras: Hair loss can come from genetics, hormone changes, stress hormones, and metabolic issues. Exosomes carry growth factors and cell signals that are being studied for their potential to support follicles.
Exosomes are injected into the upper layer of the scalp, sometimes with a local anesthetic for comfort. Tenderness usually fades within a day or two.
New growth may begin in two to three months and is usually more visible by six months, continuing for about a year. Dr. Khan reassesses at six to eight months before any additional treatment.

steps.heading: Your treatment
items: Dr. Khan looks at your pattern of loss and likely causes.
Exosomes injected across the thinning areas.
Growth reviewed at six to eight months.

faq: No exosome product is FDA-approved to treat hair loss. Dr. Khan offers it as one option and reviews alternatives with you.
A local anesthetic may be used. Mild tenderness usually resolves within 24 to 48 hours.
Early growth may appear in two to three months, with more visible change by six months. Results vary.

next.heading: Start before thinning goes further.
next.para: Dr. Khan will evaluate the pattern of hair loss, look for possible causes, and explain whether exosome treatment makes sense.
